patch_description: Implements the recommended Q-scheduling: the 2-state [level, slope] Kalman filter is kept exactly as in the best-performing prior generation, but the process noise is now scheduled by local volatility. A rolling MAD-based local volatility estimate v_i is computed from first differences; Q_i = 0.05·med_diff²·(1 + v_i/median(v)) lets the filter stay rigid in quiet regions (fewer false reversals and slope changes) while tracking fast genuine dynamics (lower lag error, better responsiveness). Measurement outlier gating and the RTS smoother recursion (np.linalg.solve-based) are unchanged. No curvature state (failed in three rounds), no slope lead (regressed the current program), keeping the localized reversal-suppression hysteresis as the final stage.
